guide.lead1: Pick a character and the knockdown advantage to get oki recipes (whiffed fillers → meaty move).
guide.lead2: Recipes come from frame math alone, so always check in-game that they actually work.
guide.upstreamAbout: This site is a web version of just the setplay suggestions from Tacpendium, an SF6 combo management app.
guide.upstreamMerits: Tacpendium (a free app that runs on your PC) lets you save your own combos and link them to setplays and punishes, record and compare details such as counter hits and opponent body size, and export to CSV or images.
guide.upstreamLanguages: Note: Tacpendium's interface is in Japanese; English is only partly supported and other languages are not supported.
guide.step1: In training mode, turn on the frame meter and stand still after your combo to read the advantage
guide.step2: Enter the character and the knockdown advantage, then press "Generate suggestions"
guide.step3: Try it in-game and copy the recipes you like
guide.tipVote: Use Good / Bad to point other players to good recipes (optional).
guide.tipHide: Remove unwanted rows with "Hide" (pressing "Generate suggestions" again brings them back). When there are many results, narrow them with the filters first.
guide.distance: Distance is not considered, so midscreen suggestions are often not usable
guide.rush: Extending a move with Drive Rush or similar is not supported
guide.rushFix: Use "Adjust advantage" to get the first part of the recipe
guide.multiHit: Moves with several hitboxes (e.g. Ryu's Axe Kick) may be suggested on a gap with no hitbox
guide.projectile: Long-lasting moves that travel forward, such as projectiles, give many false positives (e.g. they have already passed by the wake-up)
guide.projectileFix: Untick "Special (projectile)" if they get in the way
guide.notOverlapping: Moves or active frames that do not overlap the wake-up may appear
guide.ruleFastest: Every input is assumed to be as fast as possible.
guide.ruleChain: Light attacks that can chain-cancel are listed assuming you chain them. For example, only Luke's crouching LP and crouching LK chain, so "crouching LP > crouching LP" means two chained jabs, while "crouching LP > standing LK" is a normal whiff.
guide.ruleExcluded: Specials out of Drive Rush, and Drive Rush out of a whiffed light attack, never appear in recipes.
guide.ruleStance: Characters with special branches, such as Chun-Li's stance, Elena's spin or Alex's stance, are not supported or only partly supported.
guide.ruleNewCharacters: New characters are added 2 weeks after their in-game release, to leave players the fun of discovering setplays on their own.

setplay.slowWarning: The knockdown advantage is large, so this may take a while. You can stop it with "Stop" while it runs.
setplay.nMaxBelowMinHint: Max is below min, so suggestions cannot be generated. Set max to at least min
setplay.nMinInvalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more for the minimum
setplay.nMaxInvalid: Leave the maximum empty (no limit) or enter a whole number
setplay.safeJumpApproachNote: Safe jumps approach with a forward jump, so "Only suggestions with an approach" is not applied.
setplay.filterChainCancel: Only suggestions with a chain cancel
setplay.truncated: Too many candidates; only a subset was computed. Please narrow the conditions
setplay.targetTypesRequired: Select at least one meaty move type
setplay.gapRangeHelp: How many frames before wake-up the move's last active frame ends.
setplay.gapMaxBelowMinHint: Max is below min, so suggestions cannot be generated. Set max to at least min
setplay.negativeKnockdown: Knockdown advantage is negative, so there is no setplay
setplay.fillerRemainHelp: Suggests recipes with no hitting move: whiffed fillers only, reducing the advantage down to the given value.

setplay.votesOrderNote: Order: most (good − bad) first; ties and unvoted recipes keep the original order. Your votes affect the order from your next search.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This site (an unofficial fan site) has no accounts and uses no cookies or browser storage.
privacy.usageItem: Usage: the conditions, results, processing time and similar details when you press "Generate suggestions". Used to learn which conditions are common and which processing is heavy, and to improve the site.
privacy.votesItem: Good / Bad: the recipe you rated and your vote. The total of everyone's votes is used to order the results.
privacy.hashBody: To estimate the number of visitors and prevent duplicate votes, a hash of your IP address and browser type mixed with a random value that changes daily is used. The IP address itself is not stored, and the random value is deleted every day, so the same person normally cannot be linked across days. However, deleted data remains recoverable for 7 days through the hosting provider's (Cloudflare) recovery feature.
privacy.retentionBody: Usage data is kept for up to 3 months; vote totals (which do not include who voted) are kept while the site runs.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: The site uses Cloudflare for delivery and storage. No advertising or third-party analytics tools are used, and the collected information is not given to third parties.
privacy.contactBody: Please use GitHub issues (they are public, so do not include personal information). Because the system does not identify individuals, we cannot find and delete a specific person's data.
privacy.contactFormBody: You can also use a Google Form (no sign-in needed). Form responses are stored in the developer's Google account.
